how.title: How Kolabo works
how.subtitle: Three steps from sign-up to collaboration.

how.step3Text: Brands send you a request with a brief, budget and deadlines. You accept or decline — and contact details are shared only after you accept.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. Creating a profile, receiving requests and agreeing on collaborations is free for creators.
faq.q2: How many followers do I need?
faq.a2: There is no minimum follower count. Brands care about audience engagement, content quality and category fit — not just numbers.
faq.a3: A collaboration where instead of money you receive products, services, travel or tickets in exchange for a post. You choose whether and under which conditions you accept barter, and brands must state exactly what they offer and what it is worth.
faq.q4: Who sees my email and phone?
faq.a4: Nobody, until you accept a request. Then the brand sees only the channels you allowed. Until then everything is agreed through platform messages.
faq.q5: Do I have to label ads?
faq.a5: Yes. Serbian advertising law prohibits hidden advertising. Clearly label paid or barter posts at the start of the caption (e.g. #ad or #paidpartnership) and use the network's paid partnership tool.
faq.q6: How do I know a company is real?
faq.a6: Companies enter their tax ID and company details at sign-up, and our team verifies them and grants a verified badge. You can report any suspicious offer with one click.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how {entity} (“Kolabo”, “we”) processes personal data of Kolabo platform users, in line with the Serbian Law on Personal Data Protection (ZZPL) and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Controller and contact
body: The data controller is {entity}, {address}, reg. no. {mb}, tax ID {pib}. For any questions about your data write to {email}.

sections.title: What data we process
body: Account data: full name, email address, password (only a hash is stored), account type and date of accepting the terms.

Creator profile data: username, photo, bio, city and country, year of birth and gender (optional), content languages, social networks and audience data you enter, categories, services and rates, barter and contact preferences.
Company data: name, legal details (tax ID, registration number), industry, website, contact person and contact details.
Usage data: collaboration requests, messages, reviews, reports and notifications created on the platform, plus technical data needed for security (e.g. login time).

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
body: Performance of a contract (Art. 12(1)(2) ZZPL): running your account, showing your public profile, sending and tracking requests, messages and reviews.
Legitimate interest: platform security, fraud and abuse prevention, company verification and anonymous statistics.
Consent (Art. 15 ZZPL): marketing emails. Consent is separate from other terms and you can withdraw it at any time in settings.

sections.title: What is public and what is not
body: A creator's public profile (name, username, photo, bio, city, networks, audience, categories, rates, barter preferences and reviews) is visible to everyone and may appear in search engines.
Year of birth and gender are never shown publicly. Contact details (email, phone) are never public — a company sees them only after you accept its request, and only the channels you allowed.

sections.title: Recipients and transfers
body: Data is stored with the processor Supabase (database and authentication, EU region — Frankfurt) and with the application hosting provider. We have data processing agreements with our processors. We do not sell data or share it for advertising.
If a processor transfers data outside the EU/EEA, this is done under standard contractual clauses or another lawful mechanism.

sections.title: Retention
body: We keep your data while you have an account. When you delete your account we delete your profile, requests, messages and photos, except data we are legally required to keep longer.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, portability (data export in settings) and objection. You can delete your account yourself in settings.
If you believe the processing is unlawful, you can file a complaint with the Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection (www.poverenik.rs).

sections.title: Cookies
body: We only use strictly necessary cookies: for login (session) and for your selected language. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking.

sections.title: Security and data breaches
body: Data access is restricted by database-level rules (Row Level Security), communication is encrypted (HTTPS) and passwords are stored as hashes. We will notify the Commissioner within 72 hours, and you without undue delay, of any breach that may endanger your rights.

sections.title: Minors
body: The platform is intended for people aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the Kolabo platform provided by {entity}, {address}, reg. no. {mb}, tax ID {pib}, email {email}. By signing up you accept these terms.

sections.title: What Kolabo is
body: Kolabo is an online platform connecting content creators (influencers) and companies. Kolabo is not a party to the collaboration agreement, does not guarantee that a collaboration will happen and currently does not handle payments — the deal and payment are directly between the creator and the company.

sections.title: Account
body: You must be at least 18 years old and enter accurate data. You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for all activity on your account.
Companies must enter accurate legal details. Kolabo may verify company details and grant a verified badge; unverified companies have a limited number of requests per day.

sections.title: Rules for creators
body: Network and audience data must be accurate. Showing bought or fake followers and engagement is prohibited.

You must clearly label every paid or barter post as advertising in line with the Serbian Law on Advertising (e.g. #ad or #paidpartnership at the start of the caption and the network's paid partnership tool).

sections.title: Rules for companies
body: A request must contain a real offer: deliverables, compensation (an amount or an exact description and value of the barter) and deadlines. It is prohibited to ask for hidden advertising, upfront payments from creators, or content that breaks the law (e.g. advertising products banned for minors to an audience under 18).
You may use creator contact details received after acceptance only for that collaboration.

sections.title: Conduct and moderation
body: Spam, harassment, fraud, discriminatory and illegal content are prohibited. Any user can report abuse. Kolabo may remove content or suspend accounts that break these terms and informs the user with a statement of reasons.

sections.title: Reviews
body: Only a party to a collaboration completed on the platform can leave a review. Reviews must be honest and free of insults; Kolabo may remove reviews that break these rules.

sections.title: Content and rights
body: Content you add to your profile remains yours. You allow Kolabo to display it on the platform and in search results to provide the service. Usage rights for content created in a collaboration are agreed between the creator and the company (the “usage rights” field in the request).

sections.title: Liability
body: Kolabo is not liable for the performance of agreements between users, for the accuracy of data users enter, or for damage resulting from a collaboration, except to the extent the law does not allow liability to be excluded.

sections.title: Termination and changes
body: You can delete your account at any time in settings. We will notify you by email or on the platform about material changes to these terms before they take effect.
